subjects.description: A reception desk, lounge seating, potted plants, stanchions with belts, a stairwell with railings, visitors walking and standing.
subjects.appearance_details: Realistic materials: brushed and painted steel, scuffed plastic, worn wood, cardboard boxes, cables; equipment shows normal signs of use; people move naturally.
subjects.location: Along both sides of a central aisle and in the background
subjects.relative_size: Life-size, seen from about 0.7 m above the floor

background_setting: A building lobby with polished stone floor, tall windows, warm wall panels and modern pendant lights.

lighting.conditions: Bright, even overhead LED lighting typical of an indoor laboratory
lighting.shadows: Soft shadows under benches, machines and carts
lighting.illumination_effect: Glossy reflections of the ceiling lights on the polished concrete floor

aesthetics.composition: First-person view from a camera mounted on a wheeled quadruped robot driving through the space
aesthetics.color_scheme: Warm stone, wood panels, glass, black metal railings

cinematography.camera_angle: Low, robot-mounted camera, moving forward smoothly
